summary: Full backend + frontend testing of HaulCheck Road Haulage Compliance app. 16/16 backend pytest tests passed (auth, vehicles/drivers/documents/defects CRUD with GET-verify, dashboard, AI risk-insight, data isolation). All critical UI flows passed via Playwright: register->dashboard, KPIs + risk score visible, AI Risk Briefing returns real text (~605 chars - LLM is actually working!), full CRUD for Vehicles/Drivers/Documents/Defects, defect status change, logout + login back, seed account login, Google login button present.

issues: Radix Dialog console warning: Missing `Description` or `aria-describedby={undefined}` for {DialogContent}. Add a <DialogDescription> or aria-describedby for accessibility (a11y). Non-blocking.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Add <DialogDescription> to each shadcn Dialog (Vehicles, Drivers, Documents, Defects) to fix Radix a11y warning.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py hardcodes OpenAI model as 'gpt-5.4' in summarise_defect and ai_risk_insight - unusual/newer than Jan 2025 cutoff. Currently working (AI returned real text ~605 chars during UI test) so leaving as-is; verify this is the intended model.
server.py: /api/defects/{did}/status uses query-param `status` rather than JSON body - functional but inconsistent with other PUT endpoints; fine but consider a request body model for consistency.
server.py compliance_status uses days<=30 as due_soon; not configurable. Fine for MVP.
AuthContext.checkAuth is called on every mount; sends /auth/me even when there's no token. Not a bug but produces expected 401s in console after logout - safe to ignore.
test_credentials: Seed account manager@haulcheck.co.uk / Test1234! working. Test also created dynamic TEST_* accounts.
seed_data_creation: Backend tests create TEST_* prefixed users, vehicles, drivers, documents, defects. UI test created one demo vehicle (Volvo), driver, document and defect under a fresh TEST_ui_* account.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite lives at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py; runs 16 tests in ~10s using REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Dates use datetime.date.today() offsets so tests remain valid over time. AI risk-insight and defect ai_summary endpoints are functional (LLM budget appears NOT to be zero - real AI text is returned; the 'zero budget' note in the review request is out of date but harmless because both endpoints have graceful fallbacks). Google OAuth was not exercised end-to-end (external redirect).
